title: The unit cache is kept per root set and the docs carry no measured sizes of it
goal: kbunits.sqlite is keyed by the root set as the index files are (_root_key), or prunes only rows past a grace period, so a smaller root set's build does not drop the full corpus's rows; and kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/reports/test-suite-speed.md hold no current size or count of the cache or index; found by the SP-kjqdiudr review (ST-akicahgy).

run: import inspect,sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kbfacts as k;s=inspect.getsource(k._unit_cache_open);ok='_root_key' in s;print('unit cache keyed by root set:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import re,sys;hits=[(p,m.group(0)) for p in ('kb/_self/tools.md','kb/_self/reports/test-suite-speed.md') for m in re.finditer(r'(kbunits[^.]{0,80}?|unit cache[^.]{0,80}?)\d[\d,.]*\s*(MB|KB|MiB|KiB|GB|bytes)|\d[\d,.]*\s*(MB|KiB|MiB) for this kb',open(p,encoding='utf-8').read())];print('measured cache sizes in docs:',hits or 'none');sys.exit(1 if hits else 0)
